notes.title: PHOBOS Project - Update (10/30/2022)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525243/9e6a9c0fde8841f535597ac65bc697c68163b2df.png[/img]

List of bug fixes :
- Added a few hints in the caves level
- Improved door system (no more stuck doors)
- Added boundaries to block the player (to avoid no-clips)
- Removed unwanted invisible collision objects
- Modification of the end sequence for better understanding

Hope you will enjoy it ! :)

notes.title: PHOBOS Project Demo Test
notes.content: Phobos Project is a first-person psychological horror adventure exploring the depths of psychological horror. In this experiment you have to find a way out and keep your sanity level up through different hostile environments. Face your dread and try to find the source of the nightmare !

notes.title: Test PHOBOS Project DEMO
notes.content: Let's play to PHOBOS Project DEMO. It allows to play the first level of the game : the forest !
